title: Jehoshaphat Strengthens Judah
reflectionText: Jehoshaphat fortified Judah, removed rival worship, and sent named leaders through the cities with the book of Yahweh’s law. The chapter also records tribute, building, and numbered forces. Which part of this broad pattern of leadership most clearly holds your attention?
editorialNotes: Packet 019 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling remains within 2 Chronicles 17:1-19, preserving its summary and census form without adding scenes, dialogue, motives, or causal claims.
